Source Marquiste Additions

Activate A (manipulate)

Your mind becomes clear, but physical matters seem ephemeral.

Benefit You gain a +1 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

Duration 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.marquiste-additions.marquiste-common-enhancements.Item.X5M9ZZjovQ6WJqd7]{Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Lesser)}
